hero.label: CHOUCAS · CONCIERGE OPERATIONS
hero.intro: Choucas turns guest briefs into field actions, structures independent control through READY status, and prepares owner reports.

tension.label: Le problème n'est pas le service. C'est tout ce qui se perd entre deux personnes.
tension.titre: Messages dispersés. Rotations sous tension. Équipes sans contexte. <accent>Choucas remet tout le monde sur la même ligne.</accent>
tension.photoAlt: Une employée de conciergerie replace un oreiller sur un lit préparé, dans une chambre en lumière naturelle.

hospitalite.label: L'hospitalité en action
hospitalite.titre: Le luxe n'est pas une apparence. <accent>C'est l'absence de friction.</accent>

principes.responsable: Une information possède toujours un responsable.
principes.contexte: Une mission conserve le contexte du client.
principes.anomalie: Une anomalie devient une action, pas un message perdu.
principes.rotation: Une rotation relie planning, ressources et preuves.

hospitalite.photoAlt: Chambre d'un chalet en bois : lit fait et linge de maison roulé au pied du lit.

profils.label: Un outil pour toute la conciergerie

dirigeant.phrase: A clear view of the quality delivered across every property.

exploitation.phrase: From brief to control, they see what actually requires attention.

brief.label: The Choucas flow
brief.titre: From the brief <accent>to READY. From READY to proof.</accent>

brief.texte: A request received by message, call, email or note is structured into actions. The field team receives what needs to be done, when, and the context needed to understand why.
brief.resultat: What was requested becomes what needs to be done.

controle.texte: A completed mission is reviewed by someone other than the person who carried it out.
controle.resultat: A second pair of eyes before the property is declared ready.

pret.titre: Check-in relies on one clear state.
pret.texte: Once the required missions are completed and controlled, the property can move to READY. The manager knows which homes can actually welcome their guests.
pret.resultat: READY is a validated state, not a progress percentage.

rapport.texte: Photos, actions, controls and attention points can feed an owner report prepared in Choucas and reviewed before it is sent.
rapport.resultat: Clear proof of the work completed on the property.

briefIntake.label: The stay brief
briefIntake.intro: A call the night before, a message at 9 pm, an email from the client's assistant. Choucas gathers them into a single brief, the manager settles what conflicts, and the field receives one instruction.
briefIntake.sequenceAria: From brief received to instruction sent, in three stages

liaisons.rassemble: gathered into a single brief, the original text kept
liaisons.arbitre: settled by Sophie M., operations manager

appel.mot: “The parents sleep on the ground floor.”

arbitrage.corps: “Nobody before 9 am” and “pancakes every morning” cannot both hold. Choucas does not pass the two along blindly: it states the conflict and offers the options.
arbitrage.meta: No line is left hanging: it is assigned, or set aside knowingly.

consigne.texte: Breakfast laid out the evening before, delivered at 8:45. Entry to the house from 9:00. Ground-floor bedroom for the parents, double bed.
consigne.meta: Sent to Marie L. · Field team · not the brief's forty lines

pret.label: Independent control · READY
pret.corps: The person controlling the mission is not the person who carried it out. The property moves to READY only after validation — before check-in.
pret.etapesAria: The three states of a mission, in order

preparer.titre: Les rotations du jour sont prêtes avant le café.
preparer.texte: Le planning relie les séjours, les missions et les ressources : chacun sait où aller, avec quoi, et pourquoi. Les briefs de la veille sont déjà décomposés en consignes attribuées.

coordonner.titre: Ce qui change la journée remonte, le reste avance
coordonner.texte: Une arrivée décalée, un équipier absent, un accès qui ne répond pas. Choucas ne montre au manager que ce qui demande une décision. Les missions normales continuent sans lui.

controler.texte: La mission est faite, la photo est là. Une autre personne que celle qui a exécuté ouvre le contrôle et valide. C'est cette règle qui fait passer le bien en PRÊT.

accueillir.titre: La consigne du matin est tenue
accueillir.texte: Le lit bébé demandé à 8h est en place, contrôlé, prouvé. Le bien est PRÊT avant que les clients ne sonnent, et le manager n'a rien eu à vérifier lui-même.

manager.label: Demonstration · Choucas Manager
manager.captureAlt: Bloc Exceptions de Choucas : le Chalet La Tournette en critique, avec le signalement de l'intervenante et deux actions possibles, puis deux chalets en attente de contrôle.
manager.lienDemo: Ouvrir la démonstration Choucas dans un nouvel onglet
manager.titre: When everything is running normally, <accent>Choucas stays quiet.</accent>
manager.intro: The manager sees what changes the state of a property: an exception, a control to complete or a decision to make. Everything else keeps moving.

terrain.label: The brief reaches the field
terrain.titre: The field team knows what to do. <accent>And why.</accent>
terrain.intro: Every mission keeps the useful context from the brief. The team receives more than a task: they understand what is expected before they act.

points.consigne: A clear instruction from the validated brief
points.contexte: Guest context remains available to the team
points.preuves: Photos and issues feed back into control

terrain.captureAlt: Carte Maintenant de l'application terrain : ménage en cours depuis 13:15 au Chalet Balme, progression 11 sur 24, consignes à savoir avant d'entrer et bouton Reprendre la mission.

ctaFinal.label: Show us one of your turnovers
ctaFinal.titre: The field changes. <accent>Your standard does not.</accent>
ctaFinal.intro: In 30 minutes, we start from one of your briefs, the way you control properties and your check-ins, then show how Choucas fits into that chain.

rapport.intro: Concierge teams perform controls, interventions and checks every day that owners rarely see. Choucas turns those operational proofs into a report ready for review.
rapport.micro: The manager reviews it before sending.

philosophie.label: A different way to operate
philosophie.titre: We measure properties and missions. <accent>Never people.</accent>
philosophie.intro: Choucas follows operational state and surfaces what requires a decision, control or intervention. It is not designed to turn field teams into productivity dashboards.

implantation.titre: Your operations. <accent>Configured with you, on site.</accent>
implantation.intro: Montrez-moi comment vous travaillez aujourd'hui. On adapte Choucas à votre terrain pour demain.
implantation.cloture: One product. A configuration adapted to your operation.

definition.r: Choucas is an operations system for concierge companies. It turns requests into actions, supports field teams, separates execution from quality control and follows property status all the way to READY.

etat-pret.r: READY qualifies a property after review. A completed mission does not automatically mean the property is ready for the next arrival.

qui-controle.r: A person cannot review a mission they executed themselves.

hors-reseau.r: The product is designed with a local queue so teams can keep working and synchronize when connectivity returns. Urgent alerts immediately attempt the available channels.

envois-automatiques.q: Are owner or contractor messages sent automatically?
envois-automatiques.r: No. Choucas can prepare information and automate internal workflows, but external communication requires review and a human action.

implantation.r: The Choucas team spends a day with the concierge company to observe operations, structure workflows, configure Choucas and test the configuration with the team.

remplace-pms.r: Choucas is designed for the operational layer between requests, field execution, quality control and reporting. It does not replace a PMS or a channel manager.

surveillance.r: No. The product doctrine is to measure properties and missions, never people. Choucas is not built around individual rankings or employee performance counters.
